items.headline: Mizuho Upgrades Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded ALB Neutral->Outperform, $130 PT; BESS demand tipping lithium balance favorable; lowest-cost producer.

items.headline: Albemarle gains as Mizuho upgrades stock on surging energy storage demand
items.snippet: ALB +4% premarket; Benchmark lithium carbonate forecast $22,500/t 2027, $19,500/t 2028.

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Zacks Rank #5; Q3/Q4 EPS estimates cut 13%/36% since Q2; lithium ~80% below 2022 highs.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus keeps Buy; lithium up ~67% y/y, supply/demand improving into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO keeps Outperform; lowers lithium targets on spot weakness, group oversold.
